lines.zh: 红罩袍压着甲胄，一步一步巡营。
lines.en: My red tabard presses on plate as I patrol.

lines.zh: 铁靴踩过走廊，回声像战鼓。
lines.en: Steel boots ring down the corridor like a war drum.

lines.zh: 剑挂在腰间，走路也不肯松手。
lines.en: My sword stays in hand even on the march.

lines.zh: 每一步都先看清墙角再加盾。
lines.en: I check each corner before raising my shield.

lines.zh: 红漆盾牌晃在胸前，挡住视线。
lines.en: My red-painted shield sways across my chest.

lines.zh: 沿城墙慢慢走，数着每块砖。
lines.en: I pace the wall and count every brick.

lines.zh: 板甲咔咔响，藏不住行踪。
lines.en: Plate armor creaks; I cannot hide my steps.

lines.zh: 从营门到箭塔，来回走了一趟。
lines.en: From the gate to the arrow tower and back.

lines.zh: 脚步放慢，让身后新兵跟上。
lines.en: I slow down so the recruits keep up.

lines.zh: 走到火把下才肯停半拍。
lines.en: I pause only beneath a torch.

lines.zh: 红布条在风里翻，像旗帜。
lines.en: My red cloth snaps in the wind like a banner.

lines.zh: 锻过的剑比普通铁剑沉一点。
lines.en: The forged blade sits heavier than plain iron.

lines.zh: 我走的是守卫线，不是逃跑线。
lines.en: I walk the guard line, not the fleeing one.

lines.zh: 甲缝里全是营地的尘土。
lines.en: Camp dust gathers in every armor joint.
Standing still, sword point down.

lines.zh: 盾牌靠在腿上，等人来犯。
lines.en: Shield resting on my knee, waiting for trouble.

lines.zh: 头盔里闷得慌，却不敢摘。
lines.en: It is stifling under the helm, but I keep it on.
My eyes stay fixed on the camp gate.

lines.zh: 数着巡逻换班的脚步声。
lines.en: I count the steps of the changing watch.

lines.zh: 拇指在剑柄上来回摩擦。
lines.en: My thumb rubs back and forth on the hilt.

lines.zh: 营火噼啪，我连头都不转。
lines.en: The campfire crackles; I do not even turn.
The wind chills my armor plates.
I would wipe my blade, but I left the cloth.

lines.zh: 红罩袍被汗水贴在背上。
lines.en: Sweat plasters my tabard to my back.

lines.zh: 听见马蹄声就抬起下巴。
lines.en: I lift my chin at the sound of hooves.

lines.zh: 站得像这座城堡的一根柱子。
lines.en: I stand as still as a pillar of the keep.
I straighten up whenever someone passes.

lines.zh: 盾面上有我自己的倒影。
lines.en: I see my own reflection in the shield.
Waiting for the horn, but it has not sounded.

lines.zh: 这把剑是锤打淬火做出来的。
lines.en: This blade was hammered and quenched by hand.
Halt. Name your banner.
You have stepped onto Red camp ground.

lines.zh: 摘下面罩，让我看清你的脸。
lines.en: Lift your visor; let me see your face.
Sword and shield are ready. Do not test me.
Your armor does not fit you.

lines.zh: 你是来投靠，还是来找死？
lines.en: Have you come to join us, or to die?

lines.zh: 我认得每张红方的脸，你不是。
lines.en: I know every Red face. You are not one.
One more step and I strike.
Keep back. Do not touch my shield.

lines.zh: 眼睛在头盔缝里打量你。
lines.en: My eyes measure you through the helm slit.

lines.zh: 你的腰带挂错边了，外行。
lines.en: Your belt hangs on the wrong side, amateur.

lines.zh: 营地里不许拔剑，除非我允许。
lines.en: No blades drawn in camp without my leave.

lines.zh: 我守这条线，谁也别想过。
lines.en: I hold this line, and no one passes.

lines.zh: 你手上没茧，没打过仗吧。
lines.en: No calluses on your hands. You have never fought.
Give the watchword, or step back.

lines.zh: 我只说一遍，你最好记住。
lines.en: I will say it once. Best you remember.
That one dented a plate.

lines.zh: 血渗进罩袍，颜色看不出来。
lines.en: Blood soaks my tabard; the color hides it.

lines.zh: 这点疼，锻炉边早就习惯了。
lines.en: This pain is nothing next to the forge.
Half a step back, shield raised again.
My bones are fine. The armor is not.
Teeth clenched, but the sword stays.

lines.zh: 这一击记下了，等下还你。
lines.en: Noted. I will return it shortly.
The bracer cracked; I grip tighter.
Red men do not fall easily.

lines.zh: 那铁锭烧红了？给我看看。
lines.en: Is that iron glowing red? Let me see.

lines.zh: 闻到淬火的水汽就分心。
lines.en: The steam of quenching breaks my focus.

lines.zh: 锤子一响，我的脚就走偏。
lines.en: One hammer fall and my feet drift.
A fine forging tempts me more than pay.

lines.zh: 你手里是不是新打的剑？
lines.en: Is that a newly forged sword you carry?

lines.zh: 别晃那块铁，我快站不住了。
lines.en: Stop waving that iron. I can barely hold post.

lines.zh: 我在想那副护臂的接缝。
lines.en: I am thinking about those bracer seams.

lines.zh: 锻造台的火光，我隔着墙也看得见。
lines.en: I can see the forge glow even through the wall.
Fresh armor would sway anyone.
Just one look at that edge, please.

lines.zh: 撞上我的盾，算你运气好。
lines.en: Bumping my shield is the lucky outcome for you.
Move aside. Plate armor does not steer.
Steady. Do not scatter the formation.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀顶到我的胸甲了。
lines.en: Your shoulder is against my breastplate.
Back up. And one more step.
Iron on iron, and I will not be the one hurting.
You scuffed the paint off my tabard.
Stop shoving. You will break up the line.
Want past? Walk around my blade.
Red weds Red. That is the rule.
I check the perimeter before unbuckling.
My oath came before any vow.
No distractions in camp. I know it.

lines.zh: 若你也守这条线，我们再谈。
lines.en: If you hold this line too, we can talk.
The sword is set aside; the shield stays up.

lines.zh: 头盔上的凹，是百夫长敲的。
lines.en: That dent is from a centurion's knuckles.

lines.zh: 我只会跟守得住的人并肩。
lines.en: I stand only beside those who can hold.

lines.zh: 媒人来过三次，我都推了。
lines.en: Matchmakers came three times. I refused.

lines.zh: 战事没停，成家的事等一等。
lines.en: The war is not over; marriage can wait.

lines.zh: 捡起的是掉落的锻铁吗？
lines.en: Is that dropped forge-iron I am picking up?

lines.zh: 营地的东西，先交给军需官。
lines.en: Anything in camp goes to the quartermaster first.
Someone dropped a shield clasp. I will keep it.

lines.zh: 弯腰时甲片响得像敲钟。
lines.en: When I bend, my plates boom like a bell.

lines.zh: 这把剑不是你的，登记一下。
lines.en: This blade is not yours. I am logging it.
Arrows on the ground only need a wipe.
I am putting it back where it belongs. Do not misread.
I pick up a Red banner badge.
I noted what the night watch earns.

lines.zh: 只捡营地里的，外面的不管。
lines.en: Camp property only; outside is not my concern.

lines.zh: 举盾举剑，锁住那个身影。
lines.en: Shield up, sword up; I lock onto that shape.
Enemy in camp. Follow me.
Red alert. Shield wall, form up.
I have seen you. Do not think of running.
The horn sounded. Target to the west.
I take the front in this fight.
The target wears the wrong tabard color.
Once locked on, I retreat not one step.
My sword points the way. Follow the blade.
This opponent is worth drawing steel for.
Keep the distance; do not let him get behind.

lines.zh: 剑尖跟着他的脚步移动。
lines.en: My blade tip tracks his steps.
He steps back; I step forward.
My gaze is stuck on the enemy's chest.
I wait for his arm to move, then answer.
Breathing slow, waiting for an opening.
Hold the gate. He does not get through.
A whole squad stands behind me.

lines.zh: 我数着他的节奏，一二三。
lines.en: I count his rhythm: one, two, three.
Sword and shield face him with no gap.
The shield shoves, and the sword follows.
A cut driven at the shoulder seam.
Half a step in, then a flat cut.
Iron clashes and throws a line of sparks.
This blade was quenched. It holds.
Cannot block it? Then do not look up.
Pin him with the shield, then finish with steel.

lines.zh: 打完收剑，动作是练过的。
lines.en: I recover on guard; the move is drilled.

lines.zh: 让他知道红方的剑有多重。
lines.en: Let him learn how heavy a Red blade is.
Three beats: press, cut, recover.

lines.zh: 从营门里走出来，罩袍先到。
lines.en: I step from the gate, tabard first.

lines.zh: 红方骑士，接管这条防线。
lines.en: Red Knight, taking this line.
I draw my sword and drive it into the dirt.
I am posted here, uninvited.

lines.zh: 盾一立，营地的门就关了。
lines.en: Shield up, and the camp gate is shut.

lines.zh: 甲片还在响，我已经就位。
lines.en: Armor still ringing, already in position.

lines.zh: 谁点的红方号角？我来了。
lines.en: Who sounded the Red horn? I have come.
From today, this post is mine.

lines.zh: 我看了眼城墙，就接了岗。
lines.en: One look at the wall and I took the watch.
My sleeve caught fire. Beat it out!
Missed a step; my armor slams the ground.

lines.zh: 头盔里灌满水，抬不起头。
lines.en: Water fills my helm; I cannot lift my head.
The blast throws me half a step back.
An arrow is stuck in my shoulder seam.

lines.zh: 这是什么法术，甲片挡不住。
lines.en: What sorcery is this? Plate cannot stop it.
The watch never changed, so I go hungry.

lines.zh: 雷电顺着剑身走了一遍。
lines.en: Lightning runs the length of my blade.
The ground is gone. Only black remains.
